versioning.policy: Public product versioning begins with SC-050 at v0.1.0. Patch releases fix behaviour, minor releases add user-visible capability, and major releases require an explicitly approved stable milestone.

historyNote: Formal production release history is shown from SC-015 onward, where the current Git history uses identifiable Shateki release IDs. Earlier development commits are intentionally not assigned invented public version numbers.

releases.title: Keep the active score round visible
changes: Keep the current live score round fixed while scrolling through earlier completed rounds.
Return to the live score position on accepted scoring and preserve the existing round-transition display.
Keep scoring, Undo, catch-up rules, player layouts and published records unchanged.

releases.title: Stronger Bounce Out alert
changes: Long-holding MISS for an accepted Bounce Out flashes every visible throwpad button red together.
The dot-matrix display flashes BOUNCE and OUT on its two text rows.
Ordinary MISS taps, scoring, Undo, XP and persistence remain unchanged.

releases.title: Consistent in-game menu controls
changes: Used minimal line icons and genuine Back navigation throughout the shared game menus.
Removed the New Layout Beta menu entry without resetting its existing setting or removing the experiment.
Preserved mode-specific actions, player management, scoring and Training navigation.

releases.title: Reliable Player Stats loading
changes: Prioritised selected-player XP and achievement history before heavier secondary analytics.
Moved all-player XP ranking work behind explicit Top intent in the player directory.
Loaded full Stats analytics only when Stats is opened, preserving truthful unavailable and Retry states.
Prevented closed or superseded Player Stats views from dispatching deferred secondary work.

releases.title: Clearer player line-up cards
changes: Replaced thin dashed OPEN SLOT rows with readable dark cards matching the selected-player line-up.
Preserved selection order, player limits, naming, removal and setup navigation.

releases.title: Restore Turbo countdown perimeter
changes: Restored the electric-blue Turbo countdown perimeter around the active player score pill.
Kept the existing 20-second visit timer, warning/danger states and scoring behaviour unchanged.
Added regression coverage so Turbo exposes the perimeter while Classic keeps its released card clipping.

releases.title: Arcade throw-order introduction
changes: Confirmed lineups reveal each player’s portrait and name in the chosen throw order before play.
Three to five players use a free-for-all lineup; Skip and reduced motion hand off immediately.
Scoring and the Turbo clock remain gated until the introduction ends, preserving the existing Turbo ready screen.

releases.title: Reliable Bounce Out feedback
changes: Recognised an elapsed Bounce Out hold on release when the scheduled callback was late.
Cancelled pending Bounce Out holds when leaving the game.
Cleared Bounce Out feedback after Undo while preserving accepted darts.
Used a static Bounce Out message when reduced motion is enabled.

releases.title: Reliable game loading
changes: Improved game loading reliability when browser frame callbacks are delayed.

releases.title: Restore Turbo's electric-blue identity
changes: Restored Turbo's electric-blue active-player card, current target, score cell and DMD edge lighting.
Kept the existing strict turn-clock effects, warning colours, scoring controls and player identity colours.
Moved the Turbo label clear of player initials and preserved reduced-motion behaviour.

releases.title: Update available alert
changes: LIVE UPDATES now warns when the running app is older than the latest published release.
The version control now identifies the build actually running instead of copying the newest fetched version number.
The update check bypasses browser cache, fails quietly offline, repeats periodically, and never persists as feed history.

releases.title: LIVE UPDATES truth and mode isolation
changes: LIVE UPDATES now uses persistent cloud game and player history instead of browser-local feed or recovery history.
Legacy browser-local LIVE UPDATES presentation history is cleared so acceptance/test events cannot survive into the public feed.
Practice no longer contributes ROUND PB or ROUND WR lines; Official and Turbo round records are calculated inside their own mode history.

releases.title: Secure saving and admin sign-in
changes: Ordinary play remains available without an account.
Match saving and reconnection preserve the current game securely.
Managing saved profiles, game history and delete tools requires admin sign-in.
Pending saves can be retried, with recovery for unfinished games from earlier versions.

releases.title: Three new player portraits and winner pairs
changes: Added three approved character portraits as manual avatar choices 30–32.
Showed the matching artwork for each game and match winner, including resolved shootouts.
Preserved existing saved avatar choices and the original automatic-assignment pool.

releases.title: Readable five-player scores and race keys
changes: Five-player games keep complete totals and game-win indicators inside their header cards.
Game and match averages, numerical dart badges and long race-chart names remain readable on narrow screens.
Scores, timers, identity colours and the existing one-to-four-player and historical six-player layouts retain their behaviour.

releases.title: Stats source performance
changes: Reduced avoidable database history work used by Player Stats XP, Misfires and Power Rank.
Preserved existing XP values, achievement and Misfire rules, clean score rows and historical eligibility.
Kept the existing 3-second anonymous database timeout; this release optimises the source instead of masking slow queries.
Staged Player Stats background analytics behind critical XP/Misfire reads and reuses a fresh XP directory row to avoid duplicate view work.

releases.title: Keep three completed rounds visible
changes: The score wall keeps the three previous completed rounds in view.
Completed rounds move upward one row; Undo, navigation and rapid input preserve the latest scores.
Reduced motion displays the completed state immediately.

releases.title: Readable mobile League and Stats views
changes: Made League and Stats Back/Close controls, mode tabs and date filters easier to tap.
Kept League descriptions, player names and qualification labels readable on narrow screens.
Kept the final Premier League row reachable above its navigation and unavailable Stats values inside their cards.
Kept Turbo tabs in the selected League view after repeated menu visits.

releases.title: Clearer Home controls and game-mode choices
changes: Enlarged Home Pause, version and Admin touch targets while retaining the LIVE UPDATES panel geometry.
Made narrow game-mode titles, status labels and supporting descriptions clearer.
Mode submenus open at their introduction while preserving the existing routes and game rules.
Deferred Home updates preserve a game-mode menu opened immediately after returning Home.

releases.title: Consistent in-game Add Player presentation
changes: In-game Add Player uses the setup player avatar and name treatment, with matching guest input styling.
Back and Close remain visible with mobile touch targets, and long player lists scroll inside the chooser.
Late-entry eligibility, confirmation, player identity and the five-player cap remain unchanged.

releases.title: Correct the initial throw order
changes: Game 1 offers Amend Initial Order before Round 1 is complete.
Recorded darts remain attached to each player; a current visit finishes before the corrected order applies.
Later-game automatic rotation follows the corrected lineup.

releases.title: Bull closes missed-round catch-up
changes: At each player's scheduled Bull visit, outstanding missed rounds are permanently scratched to zero.
The player can only take Bull; earlier catch-up remains limited to three missed rounds before that visit.
The final-Bull return timer, refresh and Undo preserve this cutoff. Scratched visits do not count as thrown darts in live averages.

releases.title: Player identity and independent stats loading
changes: Added the player avatar, identity and existing progression to the Player Stats header.
Added a horizontal A–Z navigator to the saved-player list.
Let XP, Power Rank and core stats appear independently of slower target analytics.
Kept trophies and Misfires independent and labelled failed sources as unavailable with recovery controls.

releases.title: Home VIDE sparse-row recovery
changes: Kept LIVE UPDATES rows at their natural readable height, including when only one result fits.
Preserved wrapped scorelines and the fixed Home panel and navigation geometry.
Added sparse-feed and WebKit regression checks alongside the existing dense-feed checks.

releases.title: Five-player limit for new play
changes: New setup and late entry stop at five players.
New-game and restart controls reject a six-player lineup before changing its board.
Historical six-player games and their records remain readable and unchanged.

releases.title: Home VIDE dense-row recovery
changes: Kept dense LIVE UPDATES rows readable and contained inside the fixed feed panel.
Retired the oldest visual rows only when needed to fit the newest updates.
Kept printer movement aligned with the first visible row.

releases.title: Live game and match averages after every dart
changes: GAV shows the current-game three-dart average from every recorded dart.
MAV includes completed match games and current-game darts.
Misses and explicit Bounce Outs count as zero-point thrown darts; Undo updates both averages immediately.

releases.title: Player Stats achievements loading recovery
changes: Made the Stats / XP / Achievements controls available immediately instead of waiting for the full Player Stats analytics bundle to finish loading.
Achievements and Misfires now load through their dedicated player-scoped database sources without waiting on unrelated target analytics.
Scoped individual XP lookups to the selected player instead of requesting the complete v_player_xp view.
Removed a stale matches.targetWins compatibility read and use the canonical target_wins field directly.

releases.title: Bounce Out Misfire & historical backfill
changes: Added Bounce Out to the Misfires / Negative XP catalogue at -1 XP while preserving Bounce Out scoring as zero.
Bounce Out is recognised only from an explicit recorded bounceOut marker; ordinary MISS darts are never inferred as Bounce Outs.
Historical Official/Classic Bounce Outs are backfilled dynamically from saved game state and appear in repeat counts and Misfire leaderboards.
Bounce Out follows the normal single-worst Misfire penalty rule per game; historical negative XP remains launch-forward from 5 September 2026 20:13 UTC.

releases.title: Mid-game Add Player resilience
changes: Add Player now shows Guest Player immediately instead of waiting for the registered-player cloud list to finish loading.
Registered-player discovery now shows a clear loading state, and a failed cloud lookup leaves Guest Player usable with an honest unavailable message.
Guest Player is kept at the top of the Add Player menu so it remains easy to reach on mobile screens and long player lists.
Expanded mobile/touch regression coverage for delayed registered-player loading without changing late-entry eligibility, scoring or catch-up rules.

releases.title: Quick-entry repeat hotfix
changes: Fixed long-press quick entry so ×2 records exactly two copies of the held Single, Double or Treble and cannot receive an extra Safari compatibility click.
Confirmed ×3 records exactly three copies of the held score and cannot spill a fourth dart into the next player's visit.
Changed compatibility-click suppression to follow the held score-button identity across throwpad re-renders while a genuine new pointer press still scores immediately.
Promoted the real hold/slide/release quick-entry regression into normal source and built-dist release QA.

releases.title: Home Safari footer & VIDE stability fix
changes: Docked PLAYER HUB, STATS and LEAGUE above iPhone Safari bottom controls only after the Home feed/version sequence is reached, preventing both browser-chrome clipping and VIDE overlap.
Reduced the oversized v0.8.5 Home scroll tail while retaining explicit safe-area/browser clearance.
Locked ordinary LIVE UPDATES copy to one computed text scale throughout raw, typed and structured feed states.
Stopped NEW PLAYER presentation events from inheriting the default CLASSIC game-mode suffix.
Replaced implementation-specific Home footer regression assertions with outcome checks for Safari clearance, VIDE ordering, stable typography and new-player semantics.

releases.title: Safari-safe Home navigation flow
changes: Removed the fixed mobile PLAYER HUB / STATS / LEAGUE rail introduced in v0.8.4 so Home navigation can never cover LIVE UPDATES.
Restored the three Home utility buttons to normal document flow beneath VIDE.
Moved iPhone Safari clearance to non-collapsing page-scroller padding, giving the footer a guaranteed 220px scroll tail plus the device safe area.
Added regression checks requiring the utility row to sit below VIDE and retain at least 180px of document tail.

releases.title: Safari-safe Home bottom navigation
changes: Changed PLAYER HUB, STATS and LEAGUE from normal-flow footer content to a true mobile bottom navigation rail on narrow screens.
Pinned the three primary Home buttons above iPhone Safari's floating browser controls using an explicit bottom clearance plus safe-area support.
Reserved document-flow space for the fixed navigation so it does not cover the bottom of VIDE or make Admin unreachable.
Updated mobile regression coverage to require fixed positioning and minimum Safari toolbar clearance.

releases.title: Home VIDE sequencing & Safari footer clearance
changes: VIDE now begins visually blank on a full page reload, while persisted and cloud-backed feed history remains available to the printer buffer.
Classic/Turbo/Practice result rows type mode/time first and only then begin typing the player scoreline on the row beneath, rather than typing one combined line and reflowing afterward.
Added extra iPhone Safari trailing clearance so PLAYER HUB, STATS and LEAGUE can scroll fully above the floating browser controls.
Expanded LIVE UPDATES regression coverage for blank reload state, structured two-stage typing and mobile footer clearance.

releases.title: Home mobile layout stability
changes: Locked the Home LIVE UPDATES (VIDE) panel to stable width-derived mobile geometry so long or wrapped feed content no longer changes the panel height.
Normalised Home text sizing against iOS Safari text autosizing so feed and navigation typography remains consistent.
Added bottom safe-area and Safari toolbar scroll clearance so PLAYER HUB, STATS and LEAGUE remain fully reachable on iPhone.
Added regression coverage proving a long result cannot resize VIDE and that the Home screen retains mobile bottom clearance.

releases.title: LIVE UPDATES live-acceptance remediation
changes: Restored the fuller Home/LIVE UPDATES vertical composition after the v0.8.0 compact height clamp shortened the page.
LIVE UPDATES now enters Home in PLAYING state every time; Pause is no longer sticky across Home re-entry.
The first successful data sync fills the visible feed immediately instead of starting blank and slowly typing fifteen rows upward.

NEW PLAYER feed events now persist as presentation history across refresh on the creating device, while recent joins are also rebuilt from the cloud-synced saved-player cache when available; neither path becomes player-data authority.
Normal game rows now place mode/time on the first line and player names/scores on the line beneath.
Add Player and Player Hub saves now force SAVING feedback to paint and show a brief SAVED confirmation before closing.

releases.title: LIVE UPDATES stability & pause
changes: Removed a competing first-load compatibility rebuild that forced LIVE UPDATES from the canonical 15-row renderer down to 9 rows before it expanded again.
Kept the LIVE UPDATES row nodes mounted and updated their contents in place so refreshes and injected events no longer rebuild the table unnecessarily.
Added a discreet Pause/Play control that stops feed motion while cloud synchronisation can continue in the background.
Routed injected events such as NEW PLAYER through the same printer scheduler instead of directly repainting the feed.
Honoured reduced-motion preferences by skipping typewriter and row-shift animation while preserving the same information and event order.
Added source and built-dist regression coverage for stable row geometry, queued events and Pause/Play behaviour.

releases.title: Save feedback & form clarity
changes: Added immediate SAVING feedback and double-submit protection when creating a saved player from Match Setup.
Added explicit saving and deleting states to Player Hub profile actions while preserving the existing cloud-authoritative write path and failure retention.
Associated New Player field labels with their inputs and exposed save progress through accessible status and busy-state semantics.
Added regression coverage that deliberately delays writes to prove pending feedback appears before the cloud operation completes.

releases.title: UI geometry & menu corners
changes: Introduced semantic radius tokens for repeated controls, cards, panels, stages, shells and pill shapes so future UI work uses one geometry language.
Updated Shateki modal and menu shells to the new 18px panel corner, with 14px menu/card surfaces, 12px nested icon wells, 8px compact controls and intentional full-radius pills.
Consolidated Start Game option cards and player-search surfaces onto the same corner hierarchy while preserving the existing dark-arcade visual identity.
Formalised the existing Turbo timer ring as concentric geometry around the score panel while keeping its previous inset, thickness and outer radius.
Added static geometry regression coverage to Core release QA without changing scoring, state, XP, persistence or DMD scene semantics.

releases.title: XP results composition hotfix
changes: Corrected the post-game XP card to preserve the canonical player avatar aspect ratio instead of stretching the portrait.
Moved the player's canonical XP rank title directly below their name and removed the duplicate right-side level/rank badge.
Both This Game XP and Total XP now show explicit current/target XP values aligned at the right of their progress labels.
Refined Base, Positive and Negative XP breakdown labels so their XP amounts read clearly, with zero-value rows visually muted while existing tappable explanations remain unchanged.

releases.title: XP results & home layout
changes: Redesigned the post-game XP results around each player's canonical profile avatar while preserving the existing XP calculations and award rules.
Shows the player's canonical XP rank title beneath the profile portrait (for example Rookie, Master, Legend or Immortal) while Total XP remains in the progress section.
Keeps Base, Positive and Negative XP sources interactive so each award or Misfire can still open its existing explanation popup.
Restored the compact mobile home composition by bounding LIVE UPDATES so it no longer expands into spare viewport height or pushes the version and footer navigation down the page.

releases.title: Bounce-outs, XP detail & DMD reactions
changes: Added long-hold MISS for Bounce Out while preserving ordinary miss scoring and retaining a bounce-out marker for future analytics.
Expanded the end-game XP breakdown with this-game progress, category totals and tappable explanations for XP sources.
Hardened in-game Add Player avatar normalisation without changing roster limits, scoring or late-entry rules.
Added rare competitive DMD reactions for strong rounds and overtakes, plus comic DMD callouts when a player returns to catch up missed turns.
Added Back navigation throughout the post-game flow, including a return from Game Winner to the completed live game so the existing Undo path can correct the final round.
Fixed long-press quick-entry controls leaking into post-game and added a clear BOUNCE OUT popup when MISS is held.

releases.title: Modern HD DMD visual polish
changes: Refined the existing live DMD with a cleaner Modern HD black-glass treatment, stronger clarity and subtler display texture.
Smoothed the existing special DMD GIF motion from constant judder into a short impact, settle and gentle drift sequence.
Kept all existing DMD text, GIF assets, triggers, scoring behaviour and game-state semantics unchanged.

releases.title: Faster live scoring & quick entry
changes: Live scoring responses no longer wait for MISS or Skip presentation effects before gameplay state advances.
Added touch-first quick entry: hold S/D/T to choose valid ×2/×3 repeats, with every repeated dart still using the ordinary canonical scoring and Undo history path.
Robin Hood repeat now appears only on the score button matching the immediately previous dart; on the third dart it is the only available long-press action.
Removed the iPhone long-press zoom/compositor effect from the quick-entry overlay while preserving normal tap behaviour.

releases.title: Live averages visual polish
changes: Refined the live 3AV and MAV typography to use the same muted blue-grey, understated visual language as the Menu, TV and Sound utility controls.
Kept the existing flat average strip, divider, calculations, 48px footprint and player-card layout unchanged.

releases.title: Faster rewards & live utility controls
changes: Rewards XP data now begins loading from the Game Winner stage so the existing XP screen can be ready sooner without changing XP rules or values.
Added quiet Menu, TV and Sound utility controls beside the live player area while keeping 44px touch targets.
The Throwpad action row is now MISS, UNDO and full-size SKIP; Settings remains in the live utility rail.

releases.title: Game Win & Match Win celebrations
changes: Every completed eligible competitive game now keeps a dedicated Game Win stage before the scorecard and XP.
Canonical FT3/FT5 completion now adds a separate Match Win stage before the final Match Leaderboard.
The deciding game still shows Game Win first, while Practice, Training and Vs Shadow remain excluded from Match Win.

releases.title: DMD single-miss label cleanup
changes: Single MISS actions now show MISS on the DMD instead of MISS x1.
MISS x2 and MISS x3 behaviour remains unchanged.

releases.title: Volde-D’eux / Volde-Trois
changes: Added Volde-D’eux: each D1–D5 hit in the Doubles round records a Misfire and deducts 2 XP per qualifying dart.
Added Volde-Trois: each T1–T5 hit in the Trebles round records a Misfire and deducts 2 XP per qualifying dart.
Volde penalties stack independently and sit outside the ordinary worst-Misfire and 5 XP per-game cap.

releases.title: Version & Release Notes
changes: Added a small production version number to the Home screen.
Tap the version to open a scrollable Release Notes history.
Version and release notes now come from one canonical shipped metadata source.

releases.title: DMD pacing and motion polish
changes: Improved DMD story timing and readability.
Made MISS x2/x3 faster and punchier.
Preserved already-scored darts correctly during MISS animations.

releases.title: Stateful DMD commentary
changes: Added per-dart commentary, end-of-go verdicts and end-of-round punchlines.
Added deficit, miss-streak and history-aware commentary without changing scoring.

releases.title: Landscape TV Mode beta
changes: Added a provisional 16:9 audience display for Classic live games.
Kept the existing scoring engine and normal Live Game as the source of truth.

releases.title: Persistent player avatars
changes: Added 29 persistent player avatars and Player Hub editing.
Carried avatars through setup, throw order and winner celebrations.

releases.title: Catch-up focus and expired-skip markers
changes: Kept the scheduled table viewport fixed during catch-up.
Used orange catch-up focus for the oldest recoverable round and X for older scratched rounds.

releases.title: Visible Live V2 skip marker
changes: Moved the skipped-round marker into the visible Live V2 score cell.
Kept scoring and catch-up truth unchanged.

releases.title: Skip marker and Add Player touch fix
changes: Improved the physical-iPhone skipped-round marker.
Fixed the Game Menu → Add Player confirmation path on iPhone Safari.

releases.title: Implicit Skip return and mobile Add Player
changes: Skip Go now resumes catch-up implicitly on the next scheduled scoring input.
Improved mobile Add Player positioning and confirmation.

releases.title: Add Player and rules-aware Skip Go
changes: Added in-game Add Player.
Added rules-aware Skip Go including the final-Bull return timer.

releases.title: Automatic match throw-order rotation
changes: Added AUTO ON rotation of the starting player between Match Play games.
Preserved manual/re-cork behaviour with AUTO OFF.

releases.title: Post-game acceptance fixes
changes: Changed GAME OVER to a centred slow pulse.
Removed STATS from Match Leaderboard and routed GAME SCORES to the shared scorecard.

releases.title: Milestone boards and post-game presentation
changes: Corrected non-score milestone leaderboard families.
Improved DMD NEXT UP layout and Match Leaderboard presentation.

releases.title: Milestone and record integrity
changes: Fixed threshold-specific milestone leaderboards.
Restored PB/record notification precedence and cleaned Round Record holder display.

releases.title: DMD arcade language and pinball motion
changes: Refreshed live DMD callouts, round/turn information and record presentation.
Added procedural arcade scenes and reduced-motion support.

releases.title: DMD ownership and sequencing hardening
changes: Removed duplicate DMD writers and destructive clears.
Protected DMD state against stale Skip, Undo and new-throw timers.

releases.title: Detailed post-game XP sources
changes: Added BASE XP, POSITIVE and NEGATIVE source rows to the XP stage.

releases.title: Animated XP and Match Leaderboard recovery
changes: Restored the animated XP/rewards stage.
Fixed achievement detection and the Match Leaderboard handoff.

releases.title: Post-game result → scorecard → XP flow
changes: Added the dedicated game scorecard and refined Game Complete presentation.
Restored the canonical XP and next-game/finish-match flow.

releases.title: Current-round targets in score cells
changes: Restored the original score layout while keeping square targets in the live current-round cells.

releases.title: Live Game / DMD V2 modular release
changes: Released the modular DMD V2 controller and browser/runtime regression gates.
Added reduced-motion support and final responsive Live Game framing.

releases.title: Modular architecture migration
changes: Moved the app to verified modular source ownership and a deterministic Vite build path.
Preserved the existing compatibility runtime while improving build and release safety.

releases.title: Player Stats polish and Power Rank restore
changes: Kept the Player Stats profile fixed while the lower menu scrolls.
Restored Power Rank through the verified Official game-score path.

releases.title: Milestone and percentage average boards
changes: Added ALL TIME / AVERAGE views to Milestones.
Added percentage qualification treatment across achievements and misfires.

releases.title: Live Game HUD and Throwpad polish
changes: Refined Live Game HUD hierarchy and Throwpad presentation.

releases.title: Classic race chart motion redesign
changes: Redesigned Classic race-chart motion while preserving game state.

releases.title: Classic Live Game visual modernisation
changes: Modernised Classic Live Game visuals and aligned throwpad action columns.
